text_block_list.text:
(Fufu... Can't wait! I'm gonna savor every 
bit of this famous ballet troupe's 
performance!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... it started. ...Amazing. Live in 
person really is—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
............ And in the middle of a 
performance, no less...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It's 'cause you got so carried away that 
you forgot breakfast! You big... geez, 
dummy...!!"
